main_text.p: in Basiliesi Academia, me publice docente excepta & concinnata, velut mōdis omnibus amabili & reuerēdo pro-schemate, ornare visū est, ut etiā apud inclytæ gētis Silesiacæ (quā politissimis ingenijs, magna liberalis doctrinę ubertate & dicendi egregia facultate instructissimis, abundare sæpè cum singulari gaudio animaduerti) gratiam aliquam haberent. Memini V. Cl. D. Jacobum Monauiū, l. C. sæpenumerò hono-rificè in suis ad me literis prædicare, tuæ præstantiæ eximiam virtutem & humanitatem, coniunctam cum studio gloriæ Dei, & heroico amore erga rem publ. & patriam: eoq; nomine reuerē-ter mihi colendā esse censui. Decet. n. heroicorū hominū etiā absentiū, uirtu-te & meritis oēs bonas naturas delecta-ri, & Deo gratias agere, q; is publici bo-ni caussa illos excitat. Magnopere aut me exhilarauit familiaris consuetudo & συμφιλολογία cū filio tuę Magnificentię, ingenio & doctrina florēte, D. Nicolao à Burckhaus, quem memi-ni pro eo tempore quo nobiscū in Basiliensi Academia uixit, literatę nobilitati tati

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "mōdis" (the macron over the o is faint); "pro-schemate" (the hyphen after "pro" is faint, and the reading "schemate" is doubtful); "ho-norificè" (the mark at the line end may be a hyphen or a stray asterisk); "Jacobum" (the initial letter is blurred, read from "cobum"); "sabsentiū" and "Monauiū" as printed. The Greek "συμφιλολογία" is reproduced from the scan, which shows a blurred ligature. The final word "tati" is the catchword of the completed "nobilitati". No page number is printed.
